# Contract check: the immediate-return remember

**Date:** 2026-04-06
**Participants:** Wynn Castellano (Staff Engineer)

Wynn: "We ratified the async job contract: remember returns a receipt in
seconds and the extraction is watched by polling a cursor. No blocking
call, and no lost work if the client drops the receipt."

Key decision: remember dispatches, then the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call.

positions.frame: how does the async job contract structure dispatch, return, and reaction delivery so that no call blocks and no work is lost?
positions.why: All three expressions read in the same direction: the operational mechanics of the remember contract — immediate receipt return (src-1), non-blocking dispatch with polling or piggybacked reaction (src-3), and the guarantee against lost work when the receipt is dropped (src-2). Together they trace the full lifecycle from dispatch through extraction-watching to reaction delivery, held under the question of what shape the contract takes to avoid blocking and loss.

placements.why: All three segments describe the structural shape of the async job contract — its dispatch, return, and reaction-delivery mechanics — which is architectural content naming an organizational category nothing existing holds.
placements.title: System structure as ratified decisions
placements.theme: How the system is shaped — its contracts, dispatch patterns, and guarantees — captured as decisions that constrain what implementation must satisfy.

placements.title: From synchronous calls to receipt-and-poll async dispatch
placements.theme: The remember contract returns an immediate receipt and defers extraction-watching to polling or piggybacked reaction, so no call blocks and no work is lost even if the receipt is dropped.
placements.why: The three segments together trace the full lifecycle of the async job contract — immediate receipt return (src-1), non-blocking dispatch with polling or piggybacked reaction (src-3), and the guarantee against lost work when the receipt is dropped (src-2). This names a thematic subject future envelopes will keep feeding: the design space of non-blocking async dispatch with durability guarantees.
